verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: X20 Kaioken Kamehameha — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies X20 Kaioken Kamehameha as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 500 Ki, with beam, pseudo-Strike, long-range, 23-hit, and knockback characteristics.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material lists the Skill Shop as the unlock route. Community reports indicate the skill may be progression-gated by story completion; the exact shop appearance condition is not promoted as canonical because the primary current reference only states Skill Shop.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the documented acquisition route is the Skill Shop and no qualifying Ultimate Finish evidence is applicable.
verification_audit.variant_policy: X20 Kaioken Kamehameha is kept distinct from X4 Kaioken Kamehameha, Kaioken Kamehameha, and the separate Kaioken Awoken Skill.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage percentage is not promoted as a canonical database value because version, stats, and repeated-hit conditions can affect observed damage.

records.name: X20 Kaioken Kamehameha
records.character_source: Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God) customizable partner; Goku (Super Saiyan 4) customizable partner
records.skill_description: Activate x20 Kaioken, rush the opponent, then unleash a super-powered Kamehameha.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation describes an initial Kaioken-enhanced rush attack followed by a Kamehameha. The current reference lists 500 Ki, long-range beam and pseudo-Strike characteristics, 23 hits, and knockback. Separate community reports describe story progression as a possible prerequisite for the Skill Shop listing; this is retained as an uncertainty rather than asserted as a canonical unlock condition.
